strings.(묘하게 생긴 사람이다. 아니… 사람이 아닌 것 같다.): (What a peculiar-looking person. No... Perhaps not a person at all.)
strings.안녕하세요, 혹시 모험가이신가요?: Hello. Are you an adventurer, by any chance?
strings.오오… 그렇군요. 상당히 실력이 있어보이는 분이네요!: Oh... I see. You look quite capable!
strings.반가워요, 저는 엘피, 은빛가지 저택의 문지기랍니다!: A pleasure to meet you. I'm Elphie, gatekeeper of the Silver Branch Mansion!
strings.이런 시기에 실력있는 모험가를 만나게 된건 행운이라고 할 수 있겠죠!: Meeting a skilled adventurer at a time like this is a stroke of luck!
strings.괜찮으시다면 저희 저택에 방문하셔서, [별기사]인 [타피]님을 만나주지: If you don't mind, would you visit our mansion and meet [Taffy], the [Star Knight]?
There's something we'd very much like to ask of you.
strings.엘피가 손님이 찾아왔다고 하셨는데.. 어떤 분일지 궁금하기 짝이 없지 뭡: Elphie said we had a visitor... I simply can't help wondering what sort of person they might be. (Curious)
strings.핫! 처음 보는 얼굴! 타피는 조금 긴장됩니다요! (깜짝): Ah! An unfamiliar face! Taffy's feeling a little nervous! (Startled)
strings.하지만 나쁜 사람 같지는 않아보이지 뭡니까… (고민): But you don't seem like a bad sort... (Pondering)
strings.우짜튼간에 환영해야겠습니다요! 타피의 따뜻한 마음이 우호적인 관계를 바라: In any case, a welcome is in order! Taffy's warm heart hopes for friendly relations! (Resolved)
strings.반갑구려 반갑구려~ 별의 요람, <리리르>에 오신걸 환영합니다요! 얼쑤~: A pleasure, a pleasure! Welcome to <Lilir>, the Star Cradle! Hurrah! (Overjoyed)
strings.저는 별지기님의 뜻을 이어받아 리리르를 지키는 별기사 타피라 합니다요!: I am Taffy, a Star Knight who guards Lilir in keeping with the Keeper of the Stars' wishes! Leave anything to me! (Confident)
strings.뭐, 도리어 도움받는 처지가 될 것 같은 기분이 안 드는 것도 아니지만: Though I can't quite shake the feeling that we'll be the ones asking for help... (Suddenly timid)
strings.이런이런, 엘피는 성급하기도 하지 뭡니까. 하지만 저는 엘피의 눈을 믿습: My, my, Elphie is hasty! But I trust Elphie's judgment. The title of Silver Branch Mansion's gatekeeper isn't just for show! (Trusting)
strings.그때 뭘로 문지기를 정했더라포?: How did we choose the gatekeeper again, poh?
strings.아냐포, 그날은 콩 심었던 것 같은데포…?: No, poh. Didn't we plant beans that day, poh...?
strings.에헴, 본론으로 돌아가시구려. (진정): Ahem. Back to the matter at hand. (Composed)
strings.실은 저희 리리르에 지금 침입자가 돌아다니고 있습니다요…. (긴장): The truth is, an intruder is roaming about Lilir... (Tense)
strings.그런데 도무지 어디에서 무슨 일을 하고 있는지, 정확히 알 수가 없지 뭡: But we simply cannot determine exactly where they are or what they're doing! (Indignant)
strings.이 타피는… 타피는… 부끄럽습니다요! 별기사로서 너무나 부족한 별드워프입: Taffy... Taffy is ashamed! What an inadequate Star Dwarf I am, to call myself a Star Knight! (Ashamed)
strings.그러다 최근에 단서가 하나 잡혔습니다요. 별자리 절벽에서 엄청나게 커다란: Then, recently, we found a clue. We detected an enormous surge of magical power at Constellation Cliff. (Wary)
strings.그런데 이 곳에 가까이 가려고 하면 이상한 마법에 의해서 어느새 길을 잃: Yet whenever we try to approach, some strange magic leaves us lost before we know it... (Dejected)
strings.우리 신비롭고도 훌륭한 마법사들이 조사한 바로는, 지금 절벽 주변에는 밤: Our marvelous, mysterious mages investigated. It seems the cliff is surrounded by a spell that bars fairies descended from spirits of the night. (Troubled)
strings.즉, 어둠 정령과 달 정령을 근원으로 한 저희 별 드워프와 문엘프 여러분: In other words, we Star Dwarfs and the Moon Elves, born of darkness spirits and moon spirits, cannot approach... Doesn't that reek of a vile conspiracy?! (Angry)
strings.하지만 지금! 홀연히 나타난 방랑자! 위대하고 강력한 힘을 가진 모험가님: But now! A wanderer appears! An adventurer of great and mighty power! (Excited)
strings.이는 별지기님의 인도가 틀림없습니다요! (대흥분): Surely this is the Keeper of the Stars' guidance! (Very excited)
strings.부디, 별자리 절벽에서 무슨 일이 일어나고 있는지 살펴봐주시기 바랍니다요: Please, find out what is happening at Constellation Cliff! (Pleading)
strings.……침입자? 내 결계를 돌파했다고?: ...An intruder? You broke through my barrier?
How tiresome. I had just reached the most important stage.
strings.(음침한 마법의 기운이 느껴진다. 안개속에서 소녀의 형상같은 것이 보이기: (You sense a sinister magic. The shape of a girl begins to emerge from the mist.)
strings.자아, 백년간 쌓아둔 당신의 공포와 고통, 두려움과 증오… 그 모두를…: Now, all the terror and pain, fear and hatred you've stored up over a hundred years... Every bit of it...
strings.호오…? 루세리아도 미숙하나마 발푸르기스의 말예거늘, 그녀를 이리 쉽게: Oh...? Immature though Luceria may be, she is still a descendant of Walpurgis. Defeating her so easily is impressive.
Now that I look at you, aren't you the adventurers I met at my mansion? Forgive me... It has been some time. Have you been well?
strings.(어쩐지 낯익은 인상이긴 하지만, 처음 보는 소녀임에 틀림 없다….): (She does seem somehow familiar, but you're certain you've never seen this girl before...)
strings.아핫, 나를 없애려고 그렇게 노력하더니만, 벌써 잊었단 말이야?: Aha! You tried so hard to destroy me, and you've forgotten already?
strings.(판도라… 고딕 룸에서 레비 아렌스를 구출할때 싸웠던 포우 저택의 주인이: (Pandora... The mistress of Poe Mansion, whom you fought while rescuing Levi Arens from the Gothic Room. Her appearance has changed completely...)
strings.아, 이 모습 때문에 못 알아 본걸까? 이런 모습이 된건 물론…. 그대들: Ah, is this appearance why you didn't recognize me? As for why I look like this... Naturally, it's thanks to you.
strings.포우 저택의 싸움에서 죽을 뻔한 덕분에, 내 힘의 태반을 잃어버린 여파라: You nearly killed me in our fight at Poe Mansion. You could call this the result of losing most of my power.
And so I ended up in this body.
strings.…………하지만 어쩐지 고맙다고 해야 할 것 같은 기분이…?: ...Though, for some reason, I feel as if I ought to thank you...?
strings.2. 방금 싸운 소녀는?: 2. Who was the girl we just fought?
That was Luceria. [Luceria the Beguiler]. Once, she was a promising witch.
The two of us were on such friendly terms that we tried to kill each other. Hehehe...
strings.뭐어, 실은 내 쪽에선, 그녀가 왠지 나에게 집착해서 할 수 없이 상대한: Well, in truth, she was inexplicably obsessed with me. I merely dealt with her because I had no choice.
Eventually I grew tired of it, so about a hundred years ago, I pulled out her soul and sealed it in a doll.
strings.인형속에 함께 봉인된 천마리의 마수와 함께 지금쯤 즐거운 시간을 보내고: I'm sure she's having a wonderful time with the thousand magical beasts sealed in there with her.
strings.흐음… 뭐라고 설명해야 할지. 리리르의 <하늘>에 가득찬 강대한 마력의: Hmm... How to explain? Shall we say I made a path for the immense currents of magic filling Lilir's <sky> to flow into its heart?
strings.왜 그런 일을 했냐고? 그건 말할 수 없어. 부탁받은대로 한 것 뿐…: Why did I do that? I can't tell you. I only did what I was asked...
strings.…뭐, 그대가 상상하는 아가슈라로의 악행… 같은 것이 아니라는 것은 분명: ...But it certainly wasn't some Agasura atrocity of the sort you're imagining.
strings.굳이 더 자세한 것을 알고 싶다면, 나에게 의뢰를 한 당사자들에게 물어보: If you insist on knowing more, why not ask the people who hired me?
You'll find them in the [Star Cradle], beneath Lilir's soil.
strings.…한가지, 그대들에게 예를 표하지 않으면…: ...There is one thing I ought to thank you for...
strings.(판도라가 무언가 중얼거린 것 같지만 잘 들리지 않았다…): (Pandora seems to murmur something, but you cannot make it out...)
strings.더 할 이야기가 없다면 난 가보지. 별의 요람에서 다시 만날지도 모르겠네: If there's nothing more to discuss, I'll be going. Perhaps we'll meet again in the Star Cradle.
strings.그런 일이 있었군요…. 별자리 절벽에서 무슨 일이 있었는지 확실히 들었습: So that's what happened... I now understand what took place at Constellation Cliff. Thank you for telling me! (Grateful)
The Star Cradle... That lies at the heart of Lilir.
strings.지금은 코어키퍼들에 의해서 엄중히 지켜지고 있는 금단의 구역인데, 침입자: It's a forbidden area, heavily guarded by Core Keepers. To think an intruder has entered...! (Shocked)
strings.모험가님! 조금만 더 도와주시면 좋겠습니다요!: Adventurer! Please help us just a little longer!
The Star Cradle... In the past, only the Keeper of the Stars was permitted to enter.
strings.리리르에 잠들어있는 창성(創星)의 힘의 근원인, [별의 심장]이 그 곳에: They say the [Star's Heart] rests there, the source of the power of star creation that slumbers in Lilir! (Reverent)
strings.별 드워프는 나이가 들어 수명이 다하면 그 근원인 암흑정령의 형태로 돌아: When Star Dwarfs grow old and reach the end of their lives, they return to the form of the darkness spirits from which they came... (Sorrowful)
strings.하지만 리리르를 지키기로 한 별기사들은, 수명이 다하더라도 자신의 사념을: But the Star Knights who vowed to guard Lilir can leave their will within their bodies, even after their lives have ended! (Astonished)
strings.그렇게 된 존재들이 스타키퍼, 그리고 코어키퍼지요. 그들은 별의 요람을: Those beings are the Star Keepers and Core Keepers. Even now, they wander the underground caverns, guarding the Star Cradle.
strings.그들의 마음에 남아있는 것은 오직 한가지, 침입자를 물리치는 사명! 그들: Only one thought remains in their minds: their duty to repel intruders! They cannot distinguish friend from foe. You must be careful!
strings.별의 요람으로 들어가는 입구는 이 곳, 은빛가지 저택의 지하에 있습니다요: The entrance to the Star Cradle is beneath this very place, the Silver Branch Mansion.
strings.부디, 그 곳에 있는 침입자에게 무슨 일로 와 있는지 알아봐주시고, 가급: Please find out why the intruders are there. And if at all possible, I'd be grateful if you could ask them very nicely to leave...! (Earnest)
So you were the ones making all that noise outside.
strings.이 앞은 별의 요람, 신성한 하늘의 옥토, 리리르의 중심부로 향해 있느니: Beyond here lies the Star Cradle, the heart of Lilir, sacred and fertile land of the heavens.
strings.천지의 영맥이 하나로 모이는 이 곳은 그대들같은 불청객이 찾아올 곳이 아: This place, where the spiritual veins of heaven and earth converge, is no place for uninvited guests such as you.
strings.짐의 이름은 테세우스, 자, 싸움을 시작하자!!: I am Theseus. Now, let the battle begin!
It has been a long time since I enjoyed a fight this much! Haha... Delightful!
strings.자아, 좀 더 흥겹게 해보자꾸나! 더욱 더 나를 즐겁게 해주어라!: Come now, let us make it livelier still! Entertain me even more!
strings.(갑자기 루즈멘이 나타나 별의 심장을 향하여 달려들었지만, 테세우스가 가: (Ruzmen suddenly appears and rushes toward the Star's Heart, but Theseus blocks the way...!)
strings.이 놈, 아까부터 느껴지던 불쾌한 기운이 네놈이로구나. 창성의 힘을 노리: So you're the source of that foul presence I've been sensing! A thief after the power of star creation. Give up! I have no blind spots!
strings.……쳇…, 잘난체 하지 마 자식아, 죽여버린다!?: ...Tch. Don't get cocky, you bastard. I'll kill you!
Damn it, if only I didn't have these restraints... Well, no sense dwelling on failure.
strings.어이 거기 꼬맹이들, 너희가 앞에서 청소해준 덕분에 여기까진 편히 왔다구: Hey, you little brats. Thanks for clearing the way. You made getting here a breeze. Hahaha...!
strings.그렇다고 아까의 빚이 청산된건 아니니까,: That doesn't settle what you owe me for earlier, though.
Watch your neck when you sleep, if you want to keep it.
strings.거기 덩치, 네놈도 언젠가 콱 죽여주마. 두고봐라!: And you, big guy! I'll kill you someday too. Just you wait!
strings.(루즈멘은 동굴을 빠져나갔다. 기이한 몸놀림에 놀라운 속도다.): (Ruzmen escapes the cavern, moving with uncanny agility and astonishing speed.)
...Hmm. What a strange fellow. Why does he radiate such menace?
strings.그나저나… 아무래도 그대들은 나쁜 의도를 가지고 이 곳에 온게 아닌 것: In any case... You don't seem to have come here with ill intent after all.
strings.일단 이야기를 들어보자꾸나. 어떤 일로 이 곳에 왔느냐?: Let us hear your story. What brings you here?
strings.(타피에게 받은 의뢰. 판도라와 나눈 대화에 대해 이야기했다.): (You explain Taffy's request and your conversation with Pandora.)
strings.흐음… 그렇구나, 이 땅의 주민인 별드워프들을 걱정하게 하려는 것은 [그: Hmm... I see. [They] would not have intended to worry the Star Dwarfs who live here.
Come this way. They should have returned by now.
strings.흐음? 어쩐지 익숙한 느낌의 얼굴인데… 상당히 평범해서 친숙감이 드는건가: Hmm? Those faces seem familiar... Or is it simply that they're so utterly ordinary...?
King of the Fairies, has all gone well?
strings.오오 위대한 영웅왕, 친구여! 실로 감사하오, 덕분에 모든 일이 잘 되고: Oh, great Hero King, my friend! You have my deepest thanks. Everything is going splendidly, thanks to you!
strings.자아, 앞으로 한 시간… 이라고 했지? 마녀 아가씨?: Now, one more hour... Wasn't that right, young witch?
That is correct, King of the Fairies.
strings.각지에 만든 결계에 의해, 리리르의 마력은 별의 요람을 거쳐, 여기 [별: The barriers set up throughout Lilir are channeling its magic through the Star Cradle and into this [Star's Heart].
strings.결계가 버티는 것은 한시간 정도. 그 사이 원하는 바를 이루시게 될 겁니: The barriers will hold for about an hour. Within that time, you should obtain what you desire.
strings.에헤헤헤…. 웃음이 멈추지 않아요오----: Ehehehe... I just can't stop smiling!
strings.오오 타이타니아, 아름다운 타이타니아, 즐거운 밤이구려♪: Oh, Titania, beautiful Titania! What a wonderful night! ♪
strings.랄라라, 핸섬한 오베론님. 정말 아름다운 밤이에요오~♬: La-la-la, my handsome Oberon! A truly beautiful night! ♬
strings.(묘하게 들뜬 요정왕 부부는 폴카댄스를 추기 시작했다.): (The oddly giddy fairy king and queen begin dancing a polka.)
strings.(닭살에 보기가 괴롭다…): (The sweetness is so cloying that it hurts to watch...)
strings.거기 애인이 없을 것 같은 얼굴을 한 분들, 무슨 일이시지요?: You over there, with those faces that suggest you haven't a sweetheart—what brings you here?
strings.(활화산같은 분노를 일단 억제했다.): (You suppress a surge of volcanic fury.)
Oh dear. Have we worried the Star Dwarfs?
strings.우리가 여기 있는건 정당한 일이야. 별지기께서 지상세계에서 떠날때, 우리: We have every right to be here. When the Keeper of the Stars left the earthly world, we were asked to look after Lilir from time to time.
Once the Star Dwarfs know it's us here, they'll be reassured.
strings.우리가 너무 급하다 보니, 미처 이야기를 못 드려서 여러 사람을 걱정하게: We were in such a hurry that we didn't tell anyone. We've worried so many people... I'm sorry.
Yes. What we've waited for through more than a thousand long years...
strings.천년만에, 후계자가 생겼다!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!: After a thousand years, we finally have heirs!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
strings.으음, 정말이지 잘 된 일이야. 정말 기쁘다네, 요정왕, 그리고 여왕이여: Hmm. Wonderful news indeed. I am truly happy for you, King and Queen of the Fairies.
strings.아무튼, 이렇게 되서 우리 왕자와 공주들을 위한 특별한 [별] 이 필요하: And so, you see, we need a special [star] for our princes and princesses.
strings.3. 지금 태어나려는 별은 어떤 것인지: 3. What kind of star is about to be born?
strings.이 아이들은 장차 요정계의 주인이 될 몸, 세상을 덮을만한 큰 힘을 가지: These children will one day rule the fairy realm. They will be born with power great enough to encompass the world, but destined to face an equally immense darkness.
strings.그렇기에 평범한 축복으로는 부족해, 이들의 운명이 곧 세상의 운명을 좌지: An ordinary blessing will not suffice. Their fate may one day determine the fate of the world itself.
strings.그렇기에 우리는, 부모로서 해줄 수 있는 최상의 축복을 해주려는 거지…!: So, as their parents, we wish to give them the greatest blessing we can...!
strings.이제 [별의 심장]에 모인 힘을 받고 태어날 샛별은, 우리 아이들의 앞길: The new star born from the power gathered in the [Star's Heart] will become a mighty guardian star, shining brightly on our children's path.
strings.마녀여, 성석의 가호를 받은 샛별이 어디서 태어날… 음? 변화가 시작되었: Witch, where will the new star blessed by the starstone be born...? Hmm? The change has begun!
strings.(갑자기 상서로운 빛이 성석으로부터 쏟아지기 시작했다.): (An auspicious light suddenly pours from the starstone.)
strings.…드디어 별이 태어나려는건가! 어디지?: ...At last, the star is about to be born! Where?
strings.어딘지 알 수 있겠어요, 마녀님?: Can you tell where, dear witch?
...It seems to be close to the sky above the barrier at Constellation Cliff.
strings.아가들의 수호성으로 성광욕(星光浴)을 하면 태교에 좋을거야!: Bathing in the light of their guardian star will be wonderful for the babies before they're born!
strings.에엣? 어디서 그런 말도 안되는 이야기를…: What? Where did you hear such nonsense...?
strings.별자리 언덕이라! 좋아! 타이타니아! 갑시다!: Constellation Hill, then! Splendid! Titania! Let's go!
Oh, Oberon, honestly... You're impossible. Hehehe.
Dear witch, thank you for your help. I will keep my promise.
strings.하하핫- 타이타니아, 새벽의 영롱한 이슬 같은 나의 연인이여! 정말 축복: Hahaha! Titania, my love, as radiant as the dew at dawn! Has there ever been a more blessed day?
strings.음~ 그러니까, 리리르에서 별이 태어나고, 별이 지는 것은 매우 자연스러: Hmm. So, stars being born and fading away in Lilir is perfectly natural.
But sometimes, a very special star is needed.
strings.어두운 곳을 빛으로 비추기 위한 별… 한기에 떠는 생명에 온기를 주기 위: A star to light a dark place... A star to warm living things shivering in the cold... A star to protect someone...
strings.그러면 별지기가 했던 것 처럼 이 곳, 별의 요람에 와서, 저기 보이는: Then, just as the Keeper of the Stars once did, you come here to the Star Cradle and pray to that enormous starstone. A star is born to grant your wish.
strings.하지만 우리는 별지기처럼 강대한 존재가 아니기 때문에, 여기 마녀님의 도: But we are not as powerful as the Keeper of the Stars, so this witch helped us gather Lilir's magic into the starstone.
Hehehe... It won't be long now.
strings.(요정왕부부는 빙글빙글 탭댄스를 추며 동굴 입구를 향해 사라져갔다…): (The fairy king and queen disappear toward the cavern entrance, spinning and tap-dancing...)
strings.(꿔다놓은 보리자루 같은 세 사람이 남았다.): (The three left behind stand awkwardly, with nothing to do.)
strings.([별의 심장]이 타이밍 좋게 빛을 잃자, 분위기가 한층 휑하다!): (The [Star's Heart] chooses that moment to stop glowing, leaving the mood even emptier!)
strings.에헴. 그러니까… 짐의 이름은, 아까도 말했지만 테세우스. 어떤 작은 나: Ahem. Well... As I said earlier, my name is Theseus. I happen to rule a certain small kingdom.
strings.나는 저들 요정왕 부부의 오랜 친구여서 말이네… 오베론 왕을 돕기 위해서: I am an old friend of the fairy king and queen... I came to this world briefly to help King Oberon.
If you are curious how the royal couple and I came to know one another...
We shall save that story for another time, if fate allows.
strings.하여간에, 이 곳에서 짐이 할 일은 끝난 듯 하니, 슬슬 나의 세계로 돌: In any event, my work here seems to be done. I should be returning to my own world.
strings.거기 꼬마 마녀, 짐의 친구들을 잘 도와주어 매우 고맙도다. 어린 소녀가: Little witch, thank you for helping my friends so well. Such an admirable young girl!
...As I have said several times, I am not as young as I look... But thank you, Hero King.
Hmm. Give my regards to the fairy king and queen.
strings.(영웅왕이 복잡한 손짓을 하자 허공에 영롱하게 빛나는 문이 나타났다.): (The Hero King makes an intricate gesture, and a radiant doorway appears in midair.)
strings.자네들과의 싸움, 매우 재미있었다. 그리고 이곳의 생명들에게 소란을 피워: I greatly enjoyed our battle. And please convey my apologies to the beings of this place for the disturbance.
He's gone, then. Such an important figure appearing out of nowhere put me on edge, but it came to nothing in the end...
strings.(영웅왕이 사라지고, 판도라만 남았다.): (The Hero King disappears, leaving only Pandora.)
strings.…왜 그렇게 바라보지? 할말이라도 있어?: ...Why are you staring? Is there something you want to say?
strings.흐음? 나는 판도라. 포우 저택의 주인. 지엔디아 유일의 마녀. 그리고…: Hmm? I am Pandora. Mistress of Poe Mansion, the only witch in Jiendia. And... as you know, an Agasura.
strings.왜 내게 관심을 가지는거지? 무얼 더 알고 싶은거지?: Why are you interested in me? What more do you want to know?
Well... Very well. I'll tell you.
I'm being awfully kind to people who tried to kill me.
The Agasura's contract. An omnipotent power that grants a single wish, whatever it may be.
strings.대신 소원을 빈 자는 무엇인가를 영원히 상실하고, 아가슈라는… 목숨을 잃: In return, the one who makes the wish loses something forever. And the Agasura... loses its life.
strings.하지만 레비의 목숨을 살려낸 나는 지금 이렇게 버젓이 살아있지. 이상하지: Yet I, who saved Levi's life, am still very much alive. Strange, isn't it?
strings.포우 저택… 오래 전 그 곳의 주인은 기사 에드가와, 마법사 앨런. 둘은: Poe Mansion... Long ago, its masters were Edgar the knight and Allan the mage. I hear they made a fine pair.
strings.둘 중 마법사 앨런은 똑똑하고도 성실한 사내였어. 노년에는 위대한 경지에: Allan was an intelligent, diligent man. In his old age, he attained greatness—enough to bend the world's laws a little with his mysterious magic...
strings.포우 저택은 그런 장소야. 잠깐 세상의 이치에서 벗어나 머무를 수 있는: That is what Poe Mansion is. A place with the power to let someone dwell, for a while, beyond the laws of the world.
strings.나는 그 저택의 힘과, 마녀로서의 비술을 이용하여 아가슈라의 법칙을 피해: By using that mansion's power and the secret arts of a witch, I managed to evade the law of the Agasura and remain alive.
strings.아가슈라의 법칙… 그것이 아가슈라에게 요구하는 대가, '희생': The law of the Agasura... The price it demands of us: sacrifice.
strings.아가슈라는… 소원을 이루어줄 전능한 힘을 얻어, 지상에 존재하는 살아있는: The Agasura have gained the omnipotent power to grant wishes, and with it, the possibility of becoming living gods upon the earth.
...I don't know exactly why it happened... But one thing is certain.
strings.이런 변화가 생겨난 시점에… 세상 어디에서나 느껴진 것이 초엔, 그 어리: When that change occurred... the power felt everywhere in the world belonged to Choen, that foolish, pitiful girl.
strings.후후후… 뭐 나로서는 잘 된 일이지. 덕분에 이렇게 저택을 나와, 원하는: Hehehe... Well, it worked out nicely for me. Now I can leave the mansion and do as I please.
strings.………레비? 레비와 나의 관계가 궁금한건가?: ...Levi? You want to know about our relationship?
Long ago, a knight came to Poe Mansion.
His name was Lian Arens. Yes, Levi's father.
strings.레비는 갓난아기의 몸으로 불치의 병을 앓고 있었어. 그대로라면 얼마 안가: Levi was only a baby, suffering from an incurable illness. Without help, he would soon have died.
Lian Arens staked his own life and wished for me to save his son. I granted that wish...
Levi Arens lived. In exchange, he lost his emotions.
You might wonder why Levi paid the price, rather than his father, who made the contract. But that would be a misunderstanding.
strings.리안 아렌스, 그는 지옥같은 고통을 소원의 대가로 지불했지. 목숨보다 귀: Lian Arens paid for his wish with agony like hell itself. His son, whom he valued more than his own life, had lost his precious emotions...
strings.아가슈라의 계약은 그런 것, 소원의 대가로 무엇을 치르어야 할 지 알 수: That is the Agasura's contract. Its terror lies in never knowing what price a wish will demand...
strings.그리고 아가슈라의 계약과 별개로, 나는 리안과 레비. 두 부자의 영혼을: And, separately from the Agasura's contract, I came to possess both Lian's and Levi's souls. Father and son...
strings.…그리 따뜻하고 살가운 관계는 아니지? 후후후…: ...Not a particularly warm, affectionate relationship, is it? Hehehe...
strings.하지만 이 세계에 있어서 '이레귤러'이자 '가능성'인 그대들이 나를 물리: But you, the anomalies and possibilities of this world, defeated me. And so Levi regained his freedom.
And... now he works for the royal family. He still visits me from time to time.
strings.어린 시절 그랬던 것 처럼…: Just as he did when he was a child...
strings.내 목적이 궁금하다고?: You want to know my purpose?
My purpose...? I told you, didn't I? The fairy king and queen hired me to help them. That's all.
...Well, yes. I do have a reason.
I need the magic of light that fills the fairy realm.
Its magic is deadly to powers such as my witchcraft.
strings.가장 오래되고 위험한 심연의 마법조차 흩어버릴 수 있는 그 정순한 힘이: I need that pure power, capable of dispersing even the oldest and most dangerous magic of the abyss.
Only with that power can I... free them... him...
strings.레비 아렌스? 어떻게 여기에?: Levi Arens? How did you get here?
I followed the magic connecting us.
When I concentrated, I could sense it, like a long, unbroken thread.
...Impossible. A mere warrior, imitating the work of an accomplished mage...
strings.…흐응. 역시 레비 아렌스. 엘리아스 최고의 기사시군 그래? …그래, 무: ...Hmph. Levi Arens indeed. The finest knight in Elias, aren't you? ...Well? What do you want?
I came to escort you home, of course.
strings.…당신은 저택 바깥에서는 살 수 없는 몸이지 않습니까? 저택의 모두가 걱: ...You cannot survive outside the mansion, can you? Everyone there is worried. Please come back with me.
I'm not going. Go home. I have things to do.
strings.그럴 수는 없습니다. …무슨 일인지는 모르겠습니다만, 그럼 곁에서 도와드: I cannot do that. ...I don't know what you're doing, but then I shall stay and help you.
Lady Pandora...? What is happening? Please explain.
...Levi, this is too dangerous for you.
strings.너에게 돌려주고 싶은 것이 있어서 시작한 일인데, 너 자신을 위험에 끌여: I started this because there is something I want to give back to you. What sense would it make to drag you into danger yourself?
strings.(돌려주고 싶은 것… 이라는 이야기가 신경이 쓰인다.): (Her words about giving something back linger in your mind.)
...In the end, what I want to find...
His s-smile, and... l-l-l-love! ...Something like that.
...Hmph! Laugh if you want. I'm serious.
I will give them back to him. Even if it means...
strings.…약속된 밤이 멀지 않았군. 나는 가보겠어. 준비할 것이 많이 남았으니까: ...The appointed night is drawing near. I'll be going. There is still much to prepare...
...A warning. You'd be wise not to meddle.
strings.아무리 그대들일지라도, 마녀의 축제에 함부로 발을 내딛으면 무사하지는 못: Even you won't come away unscathed if you carelessly set foot in the witches' festival...
strings.(판도라는 떠나갔다. 타피에게 가서 판도라의 관한 것만 빼고 있었던 일을: (Pandora leaves. Return to Taffy and explain what happened, leaving out the part about Pandora.)
strings.(타피에게 별의 요람에서 있었던 일을 이야기한다.): (You tell Taffy what happened in the Star Cradle.)
strings.그렇군요. 나머지는 별 기사인 제가 하겠습니다요! (고민): I see. Leave the rest to me, a Star Knight! (Thoughtful)
strings.(일단 별의 요람에서의 일은 이렇게 마무리가 된 건가? 판도라를 비롯해: (Is that everything settled at the Star Cradle for now? I have a feeling I'll meet Pandora, Ruzmen, and Theseus again someday...)
